Lina (Partnerships): Quick flag - yesterday's SEV with an SI showed messy handoffs between marketplace, SI, and our infra. We should standardize the partner handoff path. Ideas: 1) single-point warroom creation 2) pre-approved invite lists per partner 3) fast-path roles for marketplace-only issues.
Jared (EngOps): Agree. Need a deterministic flow: incident reported -> warroom auto-created -> required roles auto-invited -> PD policy linked. Automation is key.
Aisha (SRE): Suggest concrete timeboxes: ack 5m for P0, triage 15m, mitigation plan in 45m. If no ack -> escalate to SE oncall.
Miles (Marketplace): For listing/replication issues, we should be able to route straight to `@mp-infra-fast` to avoid blocking the whole warroom. Criteria must be explicit.
Ravi (SI Partner): From SI side it's critical we have a single named tech contact and a backup in the invite list. Also ask partners to provide preferred contact method (sms/email).
notifbot: Automation note - we can support `/partner-warroom start partner=<org> severity=P0 contacts=[mp-infra-fast,partner-oncall,cs-lead] export=true`.
Lina (Partnerships): Good. I'll add a short onboarding checklist item: "provide contact.json (name, role, phone, slack_handle)". We can validate this during provisioning.
Jared (EngOps): I'll draft a minimal YAML config schema for infra: `partner_configs/<org>.yml` containing contact_list, fastpath_rules, warroom_template, pd_policy. Will push PR tomorrow.
Aisha (SRE): We'll add PD mappings and an automated ack escalation if warroom not acknowledged in 5m. Also pin a one-line triage template to the warroom.
Miles (Marketplace): I'll write fast-path rules: affects listing ingest OR publish queue stalled > 5 minutes -> notify `@mp-infra-fast`.
Ravi (SI Partner): We'll update our partner onboarding doc and send a sample contact.json.
Lina (Partnerships): Action items: Jared -> config schema; Aisha -> PD/warroom hooks; Miles -> fast-path rules; Ravi -> partner sample contact; I'll update onboarding checklist and circulate runbook draft by Friday. Any blockers?
Jared (EngOps): None. Opening PR tomorrow.
Aisha (SRE): Will schedule a short demo of warroom automation next Mon.
Miles (Marketplace): Will sync with mp-ops and share acceptance tests.
Ravi (SI Partner): No blockers from partner side. We'll tidy sample contact.
Lina (Partnerships): Thanks everyone, marking this thread as the working thread. Ping me if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
